rules.criterion: Has a reusable mapping, operator, mechanism, or structural expression with domain and codomain or explicit input-output relation.
Gives an explicit symbolic, closed-form, or verifiable solution to a defined mathematical problem.
States a new structural insight derived from functions, cases, or bootstrap reasoning.
States a testable future judgment with conditions and falsification criteria.
Provides a new answer to an existing, classic, unresolved, or previously answered question.
Provides evidence, historical context, or verification material for another object class.
